verdict.rationale: CSC documents same-day scanning of service-of-process documents with OCR, delivered electronically as searchable PDFs. Filed evidence is uploaded to CSCNavigator for 24x7 access, and SOP can be routed to designated contacts. The evidence does not show general state mail being scanned into the account, or explicit download and share controls in the portal. Missing for 10: scanning of general state mail (non-SOP), explicit confirmation that scanned SOP lives in the online account rather than only being delivered, documented download/share functions, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, state mail and legal documents are scanned into an online account where I can read, download, and share them

citations.quote: We scan, compress, and optimize all incoming service documents using advanced optical character recognition (OCR) technology. Each file is time stamped and delivered electronically
We deliver all SOP documents in high-quality, searchable PDF format
CSC uploads filed evidence to CSCNavigatorSM, automatically linking the documents to your entities for easy review and 24x7 access
We'll receive, scan, and deliver your SOP according to your routing preferences and designated contacts.
